thread:
amy: Build complete for private-vpc RC3. Artifacts pushed to staging-mirror. Need quick signoff on release notes + final manifest pin before we open the 23:00 UTC canary. Key bits: installer v2.4.2, boot-image v1.9.1, airgap delta-index to reduce transfer by ~9%.

deploybot: Artifacts: artifacts/private-vpc/rc3/2026-03-22.tar.gz
sha256: d4c3b2a1f9e8d7c6b5a4b3c2d1e0f9a8b7c6d5e4f3a2b1c0d9e8f7a6b5c4d3e
cosign: signed (key-id rwinf-2026-rotating) ; signature-verify: ok
prechecks: unit-tests: pass, shrinkwrap-compat: pass, mirror-sync-sim: warn(1)

ravi: quick note 1: mirror-sync-sim warning is about a new delta index format. Confirmed backwards compatible but older mirror agents need an extra flag to opt-in. Will open agent-upgrade ticket.

sven: Rollback plan suggestion: prefer roll-forward first (resubmit corrected manifest with patch), but fallback to pin to previous release v1.8.3 if roll-forward fails. Steps: 1) attempt hotfix manifest push, 2) if repeated failures >5min then `releasectl pin`, 3) disable auto-promote.

anita: Add to notes: known-issue: some airgap carriers may truncate tar streaming on older transport proxies; workaround: enable `--strict-checksum` client-side. Ticket #RELEASE-502.

jules: Can we have a short emergency command for oncall that both pins and opens incident channel? Suggest: ```alias rc3-fastrecover='./releasectl pin --env private-vpc --manifest v1.8.3 && ./incidentctl open --team infra --title "rc3 rollback"'```

ops-bot: Canary scheduled 23:00 UTC against 4 seeds (us-east, us-west, eu-central, ap-northeast). Monitoring hooks: /metrics/releases/rc3-canary and alertset release-canary-critical. Will post at +10m.

amy: Release notes draft: - Private/VPC RC3: Installer v2.4.2; boot-image v1.9.1 reduces init time by ~18%. - Packaging: new delta-index format reduces airgap bundle size ~9%; older agents must opt-in. - Security: cosign signatures included; rotating signer planned after cutover. - Fixes: retry backoff improvements for mirror clients; checksum retry on partial files.

deploybot: Auto-promote disabled for manifest rc3 by request of @amy. Action id: DB-20260322-3188.

ops-bot: 23:10 update: Canary healthy overall. 1 seed reported stale manifest (etag mismatch) — recovered after resync. Logged as transient. No customer-facing impact observed in first 10m.

sven: Since we saw etag mismatch once, I prefer staged promote at 30% with 15m observe window. Keep `rc3-fastrecover` handy.

amy: Agreed. Promote command: `./deploybot promote --manifest rc3 --pct 30 --env private-vpc --observe 15m` scheduled for 23:20 UTC. If no objections by 23:18 I'll kick it.

ravi: Approved.

anita: Approved.

jules: Approved, ops on standby.

ops-bot: Promote queued for 23:20 UTC. Will post results and any alerts to this thread.

amy: Thanks all. Post-cutover TODO: create rotation ticket for cosign key and agent-upgrade ticket for delta-index opt-in.
